title: Notoginsenoside R1 modulates the ATF4-CHOP-Bcl2 signaling pathway to alleviate mitochondrial stress damage and apoptosis in asthmatic airway epithelial cells.
authors: Ling, Yaozheng; Guan, Ling; Zhao, Yu; Fu, Zhou; Zou, Wenjing
one_liner_zh: 研究中药成分NG-R1通过结合转录因子ATF4调控CHOP-Bcl2通路缓解哮喘气道上皮细胞凋亡，虽涉及TF-DNA相关转录因子但核心为药物-蛋白结合与细胞表型，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅分子对接为辅助验证。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To investigate whether Notoginsenoside R1 (NG-R1) improves mitochondrial homeostasis by targeting the integrin signaling response (ISR) core transcription factor ATF4, thereby alleviating damage and apoptosis in asthma airway epithelial cells. METHODS: House dust mites (HDM) were used to establish an in vivo asthma mouse model and an in vitro BEAS-2B cell model. The anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects of NG-R1 were evaluated through pulmonary function testing, bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) cell counting, and hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining. We evaluated the effects of NG-R1 on apoptosis and mitochondrial function using TUNEL, Annexin V-FITC/PI staining, transmission electron microscopy, MitoSox Red, TMRE, JC-1, and Western blot analysis of mitochondrial dynamics-related proteins (p-Drp1/Drp1, Mfn2, ATP5F1A). We used lentiviral knockdown of ATF4 combined with RNA-seq, GO enrichment analysis, and the STRING database to predict its downstream mechanisms. Molecular docking was used to predict the binding affinity between NG-R1 and ATF4, and the expression levels of ATF4, CHOP, and Bcl-2 were validated using Western blot analysis in both in vivo and in vitro models. RESULTS: ATF4 expression was significantly elevated in lung tissue from asthmatic mice and in HDM-stimulated BEAS-2B cells, and was positively correlated with increased epithelial cell apoptosis and reduced migration and repair capacity. ATF4 knockdown alleviates HDM-induced increases in mitochondrial reactive oxygen species (ROS), decreases in membrane potential, mitochondrial ultrastructural damage, and disbalance in fission/fusion (downregulation of p-Drp1/Drp1 and upregulation of Mfn2 and ATP5F1A) via the ATF4-CHOP-Bcl2 signaling pathway, thereby inhibiting apoptosis. NG-R1 intervention significantly reduced airway hyperresponsiveness, total inflammatory cell counts in BALF, and levels of Th2 cytokines (IL-4, IL-13, IL-33) in asthmatic mice, and alleviated pulmonary inflammatory infiltration. Molecular docking and in vitro and in vivo experiments indicated that NG-R1 may specifically downregulate ATF4 (binding energies of -5.761 and -6.553 kcal/mol, respectively), modulate CHOP-Bcl2 expression levels, improve mitochondrial function and dynamic equilibrium, inhibit epithelial cell apoptosis, and promote migration and repair. CONCLUSION: NG-R1 may regulate the ATF4-CHOP-Bcl2 signaling pathway by specifically binding to and downregulating ATF4, thereby alleviating mitochondrial stress-induced damage, inhibiting airway epithelial cell apoptosis, and promoting epithelial repair, suggesting that NG-R1 is a potential candidate drug for targeted asthma therapy.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨三七皂苷R1（Notoginsenoside R1, NG-R1）是否通过靶向整合素信号反应（ISR）核心转录因子ATF4改善线粒体稳态，从而减轻哮喘气道上皮细胞的损伤和凋亡。方法：使用屋尘螨（HDM）建立体内哮喘小鼠模型和体外BEAS-2B细胞模型。通过肺功能检测、支气管肺泡灌洗液（BALF）细胞计数和苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色评估NG-R1的抗炎和免疫调节作用。采用TUNEL、Annexin V-FITC/PI染色、透射电子显微镜、MitoSox Red、TMRE、JC-1以及线粒体动力学相关蛋白（p-Drp1/Drp1、Mfn2、ATP5F1A）的Western blot分析，评估NG-R1对凋亡和线粒体功能的影响。使用慢病毒敲低ATF4，结合RNA-seq、GO富集分析和STRING数据库预测其下游机制。采用分子对接预测NG-R1与ATF4的结合亲和力，并在体内和体外模型中通过Western blot验证ATF4、CHOP和Bcl-2的表达水平。结果：哮喘小鼠肺组织和HDM刺激的BEAS-2B细胞中ATF4表达显著升高，并与上皮细胞凋亡增加及迁移和修复能力降低呈正相关。ATF4敲低通过ATF4-CHOP-Bcl2信号通路减轻HDM诱导的线粒体活性氧（ROS）增加、膜电位降低、线粒体超微结构损伤以及分裂/融合失衡（p-Drp1/Drp1下调，Mfn2和ATP5F1A上调），从而抑制凋亡。NG-R1干预显著降低哮喘小鼠的气道高反应性、BALF中总炎症细胞计数及Th2细胞因子（IL-4、IL-13、IL-33）水平，并减轻肺部炎症浸润。分子对接及体外和体内实验表明，NG-R1可能特异性下调ATF4（结合能分别为-5.761和-6.553 kcal/mol），调节CHOP-Bcl2表达水平，改善线粒体功能和动态平衡，抑制上皮细胞凋亡，并促进迁移和修复。结论：NG-R1可能通过特异性结合并下调ATF4来调节ATF4-CHOP-Bcl2信号通路，从而减轻线粒体应激诱导的损伤，抑制气道上皮细胞凋亡，促进上皮修复，提示NG-R1是靶向哮喘治疗的潜在候选药物。
